# EC2 availability fix checkpoint

- Working in `/app` on the EC2 metadata availability issue.
- Initial inspection: `IsAvailable` currently sends a direct HTTP GET and accepts any HTTP 200 response. `NewInstanceMetadataClient` does not yet accept options.
- Planned change: inject the IMDS client through a functional option and validate the retrieved instance ID under a short timeout, then run relevant existing Go tests.

item.text: The hostname override is gated by `IsAvailable`, so rejecting invalid instance IDs should prevent portal HTML from reaching the tag lookup. I also confirmed that the existing one argument constructor calls remain valid with variadic options.

 package utils
 
 import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"strings"
 	"testing"
+	"time"
 
+	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/feature/ec2/imds"
 	"github.com/google/uuid"
 	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 )
 
+type imdsRoundTripFunc func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)
+
+func (f imdsRoundTripFunc) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+	return f(req)
+}
+
+func imdsResponse(req *http.Request, body string) *http.Response {
+	return &http.Response{
+		StatusCode: http.StatusOK,
+		Body:       io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(body)),
+		Header:     make(http.Header),
+		Request:    req,
+	}
+}
+
+func testIMDSClient(t *testing.T, getInstanceID func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)) *imds.Client {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	return imds.New(imds.Options{
+		HTTPClient: &http.Client{Transport: imdsRoundTripFunc(func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+			switch {
+			case req.Method == http.MethodPut && req.URL.Path == "/latest/api/token":
+				return imdsResponse(req, "token"), nil
+			case req.Method == http.MethodGet && req.URL.Path == "/latest/meta-data/instance-id":
+				return getInstanceID(req)
+			default:
+				t.Errorf("unexpected IMDS request: %s %s", req.Method, req.URL.Path)
+				return nil, errors.New("unexpected IMDS request")
+			}
+		})},
+	})
+}
+
+func TestNewInstanceMetadataClientOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("AWS_CONFIG_FILE", "/dev/null")
+	t.Setenv("AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE", "/dev/null")
+
+	imdsClient := testIMDSClient(t, func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+		return imdsResponse(req, "i-12345678"), nil
+	})
+	called := false
+	client, err := NewInstanceMetadataClient(context.Background(),
+		WithIMDSClient(imdsClient),
+		func(client *InstanceMetadataClient) error {
+			called = true
+			require.Same(t, imdsClient, client.c)
+			return nil
+		},
+	)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.True(t, called)
+	assert.Same(t, imdsClient, client.c)
+
+	optionErr := errors.New("invalid option")
+	client, err = NewInstanceMetadataClient(context.Background(), func(*InstanceMetadataClient) error {
+		return optionErr
+	})
+	require.Nil(t, client)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, optionErr)
+
+	client, err = NewInstanceMetadataClient(context.Background(), WithIMDSClient(nil))
+	require.Nil(t, client)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+}
+
+func TestInstanceMetadataClientIsAvailable(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("AWS_CONFIG_FILE", "/dev/null")
+	t.Setenv("AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE", "/dev/null")
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name       string
+		instanceID string
+		available  bool
+	}{
+		{name: "short instance ID", instanceID: "i-1a2b3c4d", available: true},
+		{name: "long instance ID", instanceID: "i-1234567890abcdef0", available: true},
+		{name: "captive portal", instanceID: "<!DOCTYPE html><html>Login</html>"},
+		{name: "missing prefix", instanceID: "12345678"},
+		{name: "too short", instanceID: "i-1234567"},
+		{name: "too long", instanceID: "i-1234567890abcdef01"},
+		{name: "uppercase hex", instanceID: "i-1234ABCD"},
+		{name: "nonhex character", instanceID: "i-1234567g"},
+		{name: "trailing content", instanceID: "i-12345678\n<html>"},
+	}
+
+	for _, test := range tests {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			imdsClient := testIMDSClient(t, func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+				return imdsResponse(req, test.instanceID), nil
+			})
+			client, err := NewInstanceMetadataClient(context.Background(), WithIMDSClient(imdsClient))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, test.available, client.IsAvailable(context.Background()))
+		})
+	}
+
+	t.Run("metadata error", func(t *testing.T) {
+		imdsClient := testIMDSClient(t, func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+			return nil, errors.New("metadata unavailable")
+		})
+		client, err := NewInstanceMetadataClient(context.Background(), WithIMDSClient(imdsClient))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.False(t, client.IsAvailable(context.Background()))
+	})
+}
+
+func TestInstanceMetadataClientIsAvailableTimeout(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("AWS_CONFIG_FILE", "/dev/null")
+	t.Setenv("AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE", "/dev/null")
+
+	var deadline time.Time
+	imdsClient := testIMDSClient(t, func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+		var ok bool
+		deadline, ok = req.Context().Deadline()
+		require.True(t, ok, "metadata request should have a deadline")
+		<-req.Context().Done()
+		return nil, req.Context().Err()
+	})
+	client, err := NewInstanceMetadataClient(context.Background(), WithIMDSClient(imdsClient))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	start := time.Now()
+	assert.False(t, client.IsAvailable(context.Background()))
+	assert.WithinDuration(t, start.Add(250*time.Millisecond), deadline, 50*time.Millisecond)
+	assert.Less(t, time.Since(start), time.Second)
+}
+

item.text:
Updated [ec2.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go) so `IsAvailable` retrieves `instance-id` through the IMDS client within 250 ms and accepts only valid EC2 instance IDs. `NewInstanceMetadataClient` now accepts functional options, including `WithIMDSClient`. Added captive portal, ID validation, option, and timeout tests in [ec2_test.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2_test.go).

`go test ./lib/utils ./lib/labels/ec2` passed. A `lib/service` compile check failed because the container lacks required C headers. I delegated a call-site review and test implementation to two agents, then integrated and verified the patch.
